id: title:Gilbert09:stop requesting a day past freshness on google play console syncs

review.posthog_relevance: Changes warehouse ingestion end-date calculation for Google Play Console, potentially affecting retained data boundaries and query windows.
review.reason: Adds a timedelta subtraction to the returned date, changing the exclusive Play bound to an inclusive end-date, and updates tests and stored checkpoint dates.
review.uncertainty: The exact operational impact on warehouse ingestion and query results is not demonstrated by the code alone; this could be a minor boundary correction or a significant behavior change depending on downstream consumption, which is not visible in this hunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a timedelta subtraction to the returned date, changing the exclusive Play bound to an inclusive end-date, and updates tests and stored checkpoint dates.
observations.code_quote: return latest_end - dt.timedelta(days=1) if latest_end else None
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the warehouse ingestion end-date for Google Play Console, potentially affecting the last day of retained data and the query window used for subsequent requests.
